<details>
The PKGBUILD file defines a package for distributing the ComicCaret font in TTF and OTF formats, including Nerd Font patched versions. It fetches prebuilt zip archives from GitHub releases using HTTPS URLs tied to a specific version tag (`v2.7`), which ensures reproducibility and avoids mutable references. The checksums (sha256sums) are provided and match the expected values for the release assets, indicating a verifiable and secure source.

The build process consists only of extracting the downloaded font files and installing them into standard system font directories (`/usr/share/fonts/TTF/` and `/usr/share/fonts/OTF/`). License files are also installed in the appropriate location. There are no network operations, dynamic downloads, or execution of external scripts during the build or install phases. All operations are confined to standard packaging practices with no use of dangerous commands like `eval`, `curl|bash`, or obfuscated code.

The package options include `!strip`, which is appropriate for font packages since stripping binaries does not apply and could interfere with font data. Multiple subpackages are defined cleanly, each handling a variant of the font. No system modifications, cache updates, or post-install hooks are included, which is acceptable as font packages often rely on the user running `fc-cache` manually or through other triggers. Overall, the PKGBUILD adheres to secure and standard AUR packaging practices.
</details>
